items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I think, Orrin Tucker and Wee Bonnie Baker on the other side.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I would think so. Yeah. He was kidding for a day. Yeah. No, I was, I was.

Oh, I gotta tell you this, this may be of some interest. During the, the forties, I was in the advertising business. Uh huh. And one of my clients was an outfit headed by Frank Palumbo who was a big nightclub owner in Philadelphia. Right. And at that time he built the largest nightclub in the world, with the biggest bar in the world. It was something like, like it was a, a snake bar, you know, and it was something like three quarters of a mile total. And he was very proud of that. And he used to have big bands…
